source.description:
## PROBLEM

The xtrm devops docs cover (a) MCP sidecar deployment (mcp-sidecars-pattern.md) and (b) broader system vision (devops-system.md), but miss the middle layer: how agents ergonomically *access* the sidecars without paying per-session token cost, and how live-query health surfaces compose with service-skills routing. This gap meant the same pattern had to be rediscovered when wiring mcpq into mercury-infra (infra-vh4) — the realization that "mcpq IS the centralized health surface" emerged only after a near-miss design that would have built a redundant cache + CLI.

## SUCCESS

A new pattern note at `docs/devops/agent-observability-pattern.md` documents the methodology so future products don't repeat the discovery process.

## SCOPE

- `docs/devops/agent-observability-pattern.md` (new file)

## NON_GOALS

- Modifying mcp-sidecars-pattern.md or devops-system.md (cross-link only).
- Modifying the mcpq package or its skill.
- Creating any code or config.

## CONSTRAINTS

- Match tone/length of existing devops pattern notes (~250 lines, concrete, thought-process visible).
- Cross-link to mcpq package, mcpq skill, mercury-infra reference instance.
- Capture the three iterations that landed the pattern (token cost → walk-up → live-query).

## VALIDATION

- [ ] File exists and renders as valid markdown.
- [ ] All relative links resolve (mcpq package, mcp-sidecars-pattern, devops-system).
- [ ] References mercury-infra files by absolute repo path (consumers may not have the repo cloned).

## OUTPUT

- One new doc file. PR optional (operator decides).

## REFERENCES

- mercury-infra beads: infra-6if, infra-vh4, infra-mhg
- This monorepo beads: xtrm-2m3, xtrm-6fe
